data.one_liner: Parse and encode JSON in a dedicated isolate to avoid blocking the main thread.
data.what_it_does: The package runs a persistent isolate that can encode Dart objects to JSON strings and decode JSON strings back to Dart objects. It provides simple methods to initialize, use, and dispose the isolate.
use_when: You need heavy JSON processing that could freeze the UI
You want to offload JSON work without managing isolates yourself
avoid_when: JSON payloads are tiny and performance impact is negligible
You already use a code‑gen solution like json_serializable
strengths: Simple API – just initialize, encode/decode, dispose
weaknesses: Adds an extra isolate overhead even for small tasks
No code‑generation integration; you must handle model serialization yourself

alternatives.name: json_annotation
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides compile‑time JSON serialization without runtime isolates

alternatives.name: freezed_annotation
alternatives.why_pick_it: Generates immutable models with built‑in JSON support
